title: AJ Lapicola
text:
ajlapicola@gmail.com




Bachelor of Science/Arts: Statistics, Emphasis in Data Science

4.0 GPA
Russel M. Nelson Presidential Scholarship (Tuition and a half)
Statistical Modeling I & II, Applied R Programming, Intro to Data Science, Data Structures, Probability & Inference, Bayesian Statistics, Linear Algebra, Calculus I & II, Data Science Ecosystems







Research Assistant

Apply data science techniques to real world marketing problems across 4 projects in support of academic research initiatives.
Clean, preprocess, and structure datasets containing over 200 million rows and 50+ features to ensure high quality analytical inputs.
Conduct exploratory data analysis on 15 datasets, identifying patterns that inform research hypotheses
Run 20+ simulations to test behavioral and strategic hypotheses contributing to ongoing research manuscripts
Collaborate on 2 large-scale Bayesian statistical models used to generate publication-worthy insights




Manager

Supervised a team of 10 lifeguards to ensure facility was run in a safe, clean and professional manner
Created and implemented 12 weekly schedules that ensured all shifts were accounted for
Worked my way up to managerial position after 1 month of work







Full-time Representative

Oversaw 16 volunteers at a time, created goals with them and conducted training
Trained 5 leadership volunteers in their new roles and responsibilities.
Worked 12+ hour days, 6 days a week because I was passionate about the organization.
